defs.def: to give money, food, clothes, etc. to sb/sth, especially a charity （尤指向慈善机构）捐赠，赠送

ex.t: 他向非洲人捐赠了食物。

ex.s: Mike Curtin sees my arugula story all the time — but for him, it's more like 12 bones of donated strawberries nearing their last days.
ex.t: Mike Curtin总是看到我的芝麻菜故事——但对他来说，那更像12盒快过期的捐赠草莓。

ex.s: Tom is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others because he not only provides healthy alternatives to sugary drinks but also donates all the profits to the OHG.
ex.t: Tom最引以为豪Fun Bottle为他人的带来机会是因为他不仅提供了含糖饮料的健康替代品，还将所有利润捐赠给了OHG。

ex.s: People have donated more than $1, 500 so far this holiday season.
ex.t: 到目前为止，这个假期人们已经捐赠了超过1500美元。

ex.s: Donate whatever clothes are left over
ex.t: G 告诉每个人带干净且状况良好的衣服

ex.s: And then he would donate them to folks who could truly use them but didn't have the 25     to buy one.
ex.t: 然后他会把它们捐赠给真正需要但又没有能力   25     购买的人。

ex.s: I found the pre-holidays a good time to encourage young children to donate less-used things, and it worked.
ex.t: 我发现节前是鼓励小孩子捐赠不太用得上的东西的好时机，而且这招很管用。

ex.s: Because of our efforts, our daughter Georgia did decide to donate a large bag of toys to a little girl whose mother was unable to pay for her holiday due to illness.
ex.t: 由于我们的努力，女儿Georgia确实决定把一个大袋子装的玩具捐赠给一个小女孩，她的母亲因病无力支付她过节的费用。

ex.s: He used donated funds and his own money to pay the 50 pounds per child that the British government required.
ex.t: 他用捐赠的资金和自己的钱来支付英国政府要求的每个孩子50英镑的费用。

ex.s: By early May, emergency aid worth 9.7 million US dollars had been donated by China, with a further round of emergency aid to follow.
ex.t: 截至5月初，中国已捐赠了价值970万美元的紧急援助，随后还将提供进一步的紧急援助。

ex.s: The Sullivans now make about 1,500 toys each year to donate to local children’s charities, school districts and homeless shelters.
ex.t: 沙利文一家现在每年制作约1500件玩具，捐给当地的儿童慈善机构、学区和无家可归者收容所。

ex.s: Many people donate money and others volunteer to help run charities.
ex.t: 许多人捐款，另一些人则自愿帮助运营慈善机构。

defs.def: to allow doctors to remove blood or a body organ in order to help sb who needs it 献（血）；（台）捐（血）；捐献（器官）

ex.s: It helps to provide healthy alternatives to sugary drinks; and also Tom donates part of the profits to the Organisation for a Healthier Generation (OHG).
ex.t: 它有助于提供替代含糖饮料的健康选择；而且汤姆把部分利润捐给更健康一代组织（OHG）。

ex.s: She donates 10% of AilicCandy's profits to Big Smiles.
ex.t: 她将艾利坎迪10%的利润捐给"大微笑".

ex.s: More recently, the foundation began another  47  called National Red Scarf Day --- a day when people donate $20 and wear red scarves in support of Canada’s  48   and homeless.
ex.t: 最近，该基金会又发起了一项名为“全国红围巾日”的活动——这一天人们捐出20美元并戴上红围巾，以支持加拿大的____和无家可归者。

ex.s: He started to ask for help from his classmates and neighbours and persuaded them to donate money.
ex.t: 他开始向同学和邻居寻求帮助，并说服他们捐钱。

ex.s: As in the words which were spoken by Ryan, we need to not only donate money but also get new ideas.
ex.t: 正如Ryan所说，我们不仅要捐钱，还要提出新的想法。
